title: Church of the Holy Sepulchre. Note on a recent discovery
author: (unsigned)
location_note: Entrance lintels of the Church of the Holy Sepulchre, Jerusalem; placed by name. Page 2 inferred (the issue's page numbers are not legible on these leaves: Introduction p. 1, this note, then the Karm al-Shaikh note on p. 3).
notes: Conservation of the carved lintel panels: the back of the right-hand slab carries an earlier carving (10th-11th c.). No eligible feature.
